mantis_folded_arms_and_insect_grip.title: A Praying Mantis Has Two Very Different Foreleg Moves
mantis_folded_arms_and_insect_grip.script: Look at this mantis lifting one front leg as it moves in front of the camera. Those folded forelegs carry tiny spines that help hold objects close to its body. Other recordings show a mantis gripping insect prey with those very same front legs. On a quiet leaf, a mantis can pause and carefully reposition its forelegs. In another outdoor scene, a mantis reacts by raising its arms in a wider posture. From a small wave to gripping prey, these forelegs do much more than walking.
mantis_folded_arms_and_insect_grip.caption: TINY ARMS, TWO JOBS. #WildVox #PrayingMantis #AnimalBehavior #Wildlife

kingfisher_digging_and_fishing_bill.title: Where Kingfishers Rest Between Flights
kingfisher_digging_and_fishing_bill.script: This kingfisher pauses on a rounded post, tilting its head between looks. Elsewhere, another kingfisher rests on a branch beside a pond. In a closer view, its blue and orange feathers stand out as it shifts on its perch. Some kingfishers sit deep among branches, where leaves almost hide their bright colors. Another bird remains on a low branch, watching the bank from a distance. From one perch to another, this little bird keeps its distinctive pointed bill in view.
kingfisher_digging_and_fishing_bill.caption: THE QUIET MOMENTS OF A KINGFISHER. #WildVox #Kingfisher #Birds #Wildlife

bald_eagle_small_bites_for_eaglets.title: Bald Eagles: From Nest to Open Sky
bald_eagle_small_bites_for_eaglets.script: From this distant nest camera, we can glimpse bald eagles sharing a place to raise young. Another recording shows adult eagles together in a separate area of their territory. At a second nest, the family is filmed again from a different viewpoint. Far from the nest, adults perch, turn, and explore the landscape around them. Refuge footage reveals another view of these powerful birds in the wild. Young eagles still rely on adults before they can find food independently.
bald_eagle_small_bites_for_eaglets.caption: THE EAGLE'S WORLD FROM NEST TO SKY. #WildVox #BaldEagle #Wildlife #Nature

beaver_zoo_land_and_water_movement.title: Why Do Beavers Look Different in Water?
beaver_zoo_land_and_water_movement.script: Here is a North American beaver filmed in an enclosure at a zoo. On dry ground, its heavy body is easy to spot as it moves along. Watch it enter the water, where the same animal begins to paddle. Other close recordings reveal its thick coat and broad body from new angles. Back in the pool, the beaver travels with a very different-looking movement. These real zoo scenes show how one animal handles both land and water.
beaver_zoo_land_and_water_movement.caption: A BEAVER ON LAND VERSUS WATER. #WildVox #Beaver #Animals #Nature

goats_grazing_grooming_and_nursing.title: A Goat Herd Does More Than Eat
goats_grazing_grooming_and_nursing.script: Look at the goats scattered across this grassy hillside, each moving at its own pace. In a different place, a herd picks its way across rough and rocky ground. Other goats stop to eat hay, while one rests on an open grassy patch. Some goats pause inside a barn, while others groom themselves between activities. Small newborn kids stand near an adult goat, still learning their surroundings. A goat herd has quiet moments, busy moments, and many tiny daily routines.
goats_grazing_grooming_and_nursing.caption: WHAT GOATS DO BETWEEN MEALS. #WildVox #Goats #AnimalLife #Wildlife
